activeReplacementDecision.rationale: This source transition changes a function graph under vertical/horizontal addition and multiplication. Printed p66 expressly lists shifts, scaling and both axis reflections in the same block. The three atomic targets describe precisely these actions; they do not establish a matrix, Markov or fixed-vector obligation, and this correction does not independently map the more demanding combined term or derivative-symmetry task.
